sentences.answer: A translation slides a figure in a straight direction.
A rotation turns a figure around a point.
A reflection flips a figure across a line.
The size and shape of a figure do not change.
The new figure is congruent to the original figure.
A line of symmetry divides a figure into two matching parts.
A square has four lines of symmetry.
Patterns can be made using translations, rotations, and reflections.
A perpendicular bisector crosses a segment at its midpoint.
We can construct a perpendicular bisector using a compass.
Every point on the perpendicular bisector is the same distance from the endpoints.

chunks: it lies on the perpendicular bisector
sentences.answer: If a point is the same distance from both endpoints, it lies on the perpendicular bisector.
A perpendicular bisector is perpendicular to the segment.
A midpoint divides a segment into two equal parts.
A perpendicular bisector creates two congruent segments.
